hooks.text: 每个居民都有姓名与特质，既可旁观文明演化也可亲自降神干预
hooks.excerpt: Every human in your realm is a unique individual with their own name and traits. You are the ultimate architect: play as a passive observer watching them evolve naturally, or actively intervene.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从宙斯、哈迪斯等8位神祇中选3位组阁，组合近200种神力联动
hooks.excerpt: Command a roster of 8 legendary deities, including Zeus, Hades, Apollo, and Ares. In every run, you must draft 3 gods to form your divine council. With nearly 200 skill combinations, discovering overpowered synergies is the key to mastering the game.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 以信仰作为核心货币，通过神迹和回应祈祷解锁文明级神器
hooks.excerpt: Faith is your ultimate currency. Perform miracles to inspire your populace and answer their temple prayers to unlock game-changing artifacts that buff your entire civilization.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
